title: Volatilize
summary: VOL'ATILIZE, verb transitive To render volatile; to cause to exhale or evaporate; to cause to pass off in vapor or invisible effluvia, and to rise and float in the air. The water - dissolving the oil,

inlines.v: VOL'ATILIZE, verb transitive To render volatile; to cause to exhale or evaporate; to cause to pass off in vapor or invisible effluvia, and to rise and float in the air. The water - dissolving the oil, and volatilizing it by the action.
